name: publishing
description: Publish a technical article to AWS Builder Center, dev.to, Medium and LinkedIn, and announce it in Slack, Google Chat and Advocu, without the silent failures: mandatory cover images, table/code-to-image conversion for Medium's importer, posts whose links must resolve, a pre-flight check that fails the build, and fact-tracing that reports every claim with no artifact behind it. Runs in Antigravity, Codex and Claude Code.
